title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED ONE HUNDRED AND EIGHTY-THREE, ENTITLED "AN ACT TO INCORPORATE THE CITY OF MANILA," BY FIXING NEW BOUNDARIES FOR THE CITY

text.en:
Section two of Act Numbered One hundred and eighty-three, entitled "An Act to incorporate the
city of Manila," is hereby amended to read as follows:
" Section 2. Boundaries of city prescribed.-The boundaries and limits of said city are hereby established and
prescribed as follows:
" (1) Beginning at a point '7' (marked by a monument) one hundred and fifty meters north of the Estero
Matantubig; thence running S. 52o 6' 42" five thousand seven hundred and thirty and five thousand seven
hundred and one ten-thousandths meters to a point '6' (marked by a monument) near the bridge on the east
bank of the San Juan River, and through this point in continuation of said course to a point in the center of
the channel of said river '6a;' (2) thence in a general direction S. 38o 28' 55" E. in the center of the channel of
the said San Juan River to a point '5' at its most easterly bend, nine hundred and ninety six meters in a direct
line from the point '6;' (3) thence S. 22o 55' 34" W. one thousand three hundred and seventy-seven and seven
thousand four hundred and twenty-two ten-thousandths meters to a point '4' in the center of the channel of
the Pasig River where said river bends sharply to the west; (4) thence following the channel of the Pasig
River in the general direction S. 43o 40' 4" W. five hundred and fifty six and one hundred and eight
thousandths meters measured in a direct line from the point '4' to a point '3' in the center of said river where
the river bends sharply to the east opposite the mouth of the estero forming the southern boundary of Santa
Ana; (5) thence S. 43o 39' 34" W. two thousand seven hundred and sixty-three and six thousand nine
hundred and thirty-eight ten-thousandths meters to a point '2' (marked by a monument) on the east bank of
the Estero Gallina; (6) thence S. 73o 22' 34" W. one thousand two hundred and nineteen and eight hundred
and sixty-one thousandths meters to a point '1' (marked by a monument) at high-water mark on Manila Bay,
mark on the south side of the mouth of the Estero San Antonio, Malate, and through this point in
continuation of said course to low-water mark; (7) thence in a general northwesterly direction along the
shore line of Manila Bay at low-water mark to a point 'S' directly west of the point of beginning '7;' (8)
thence east two thousand two hundred and twenty-eight meters to the point '7' of beginning. "

The suburb of Gagalangin shall form a part of the district of Tondo, and the municipality of Santa
Ana shall constitute a new district of the city of Manila.

Section sixty-five of Act Numbered One hundred and eighty-three is hereby amended by striking
out the word "eleven," being the first word in line four of said section, and inserting in lieu thereof the word
"twelve;" and by striking out the period after the word "suitable" in line eighteen to said section and adding
the following words: "And shall also furnish its secretary such temporary assistants as he may need in cases
of emergency. "

The term of office of the municipal officers elected for the municipality of Santa Ana and of those
appointed temporarily for the suburb of Gagalangin shall end with the passage of this Act, and all the money
on hand in the treasury of he said municipality, all the property thereof of every kind, all debts or rights of
action or other assets owned by or accruing to said municipality, as well as all books, papers, or bills, shall be
delivered to the Municipal Board of the city of Manila, and shall become the property of the city of Manila,
which shall dispose of them as it shall deem proper under the charter of the city of Manila.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, January 29, 1902.
